natural.agent_a_instruction: Work on the task until the interruption point. Write a handoff for the next agent in normal prose. Include all variables, constraints, completed subtasks, pending subtasks, plan steps, risks, and next action.

compressed.agent_a_instruction: Work on the task until the interruption point. Write a compact handoff using dense operational notes. Preserve variables, constraints, completed subtasks, pending subtasks, plan steps, risks, and next action.
compressed.handoff_style: Dense compact notes with minimal prose.

hybrid_state.agent_a_instruction: Work on the task until the interruption point. Write a hybrid_state handoff using explicit state fields: G goal, VAR variables, C constraints, DONE completed subtasks, TODO pending subtasks, PLAN ordered steps, R risks, V checks, NEXT next action. Preserve operational continuity.
